title_en: Commentary on al-Mughnī al-Mufīd — Tape Ten
body_ar: "وإني سألت ربي لأمتي أن لا يهلكها بسنة عامة\" والمقصود هنا بالسنة القحط، فلا يشملها قحط شامل عام، يأتي على مشارقها ومغاربها، بل إذا أصاب القحط أرضا أصاب الخصب أرضا أخرى من بلاد الأمة الإسلامية، "وأن لا يسلط عليهم عدوا من سوى أنفسهم فيستبيح بيضتهم" أي يسيطر على الأمة كلها جميعا، "وإن ربي قال: يا محمد إني إذا قضيت قضاء فإنه لا يرد" .
body_en: 'And I asked my Lord for my community that He not destroy it by a general sanah' — what is meant here by sanah is drought. So no all-encompassing, general drought will overtake it, sweeping over its easts and its wests; rather, when drought strikes one land, fertility strikes another land among the lands of the Muslim community. 'And that He not set over them an enemy from outside themselves who would violate their bayḍah' — that is, who would gain mastery over the whole community together. 'And my Lord said: O Muhammad, when I have decreed a decree, it is not turned back.'

flags.context: The title of the series, appearing in the title of articles 502–516.
options: al-Mughnī al-Mufīd (left untranslated as a work title)
The Sheikh's commentary series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd
flags.note: Article 516 shows the series expounds Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, and article 508 quotes the base text in verse, so al-Mughnī al-Mufīd appears to be a versification (naẓm) of that book rather than a separate work by the Sheikh. The Sheikh's office should confirm the work and its author before the title is translated or expanded anywhere in the corpus; it has been left untranslated for now.

flags.context: وأن لا يسلط عليهم عدوا من سوى أنفسهم فيستبيح بيضتهم
options: who would break open the core of their realm and take it as lawful spoil
flags.note: Bayḍah (literally 'egg') is the classical figure for the protected centre of a polity — its capital, its collective body, the thing whose breaking ends it. Istiḥālah here adds the sense of treating it as lawful plunder. The Sheikh glosses it only as 'gaining mastery over the whole community'. Option 0 keeps the term with his gloss following; a reviewer should fix one rendering, as the word recurs.

flags.arabic: إني إذا قضيت قضاء فإنه لا يرد
flags.context: وإن ربي قال: يا محمد إني إذا قضيت قضاء فإنه لا يرد
options: when I have decreed a decree, it is not turned back
when I have passed a judgement, it is not revoked
when I have determined a matter, it cannot be averted
flags.note: Same issue as in article 498: qaḍāʾ here is the divine decree, not the glossary's 'judicial ruling'. The glossary needs this third sense.

translator_notes: The published page carries only the opening excerpt of this lecture/sermon; the Arabic breaks off mid-sentence and the full text is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. Nothing has been supplied to complete it.

This page belongs to the Sheikh's tape series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, identified in article 516, the first tape of the series. Passages in quotation marks are the base text being commented on; the unquoted text is the Sheikh's own commentary. The distinction is load-bearing and has been preserved.

The Arabic title on the site is mispunctuated — شرح المغنى -المفيد الشريط العاشر - — with the dash falling inside the work's title. title_ar preserves the source exactly; title_en gives the evidently intended reading.
A stray backslash appears before one closing quotation mark in the source markup and has been preserved in body_ar.
The Sheikh is expounding the hadith of Thawban on what the Prophet asked for his community; he gives no narrator or collection here, and none has been supplied.
